places.name: International Outdoor Terrace
places.location: International Terminal G, End of Boarding Area G
places.description: An absolute must-visit. This stunning outdoor observation deck gets you out of the indoor air and puts you right on top of the heavy international jets. Grab a drink, enjoy the California sunshine, and watch the world fly by.

photo.credit: Derivative of "Outdoor terrace at SFO Airport 01" by Phoebe (CC BY-SA 4.0)

places.name: Klein's Deli
places.description: A highly convenient and solid stop for frequent flyers. While considered a bit pricey, they serve fantastic, hearty deli sandwiches paired perfectly with their signature tomato bisque soup, house-made deli salads, or pastries, and easily grab snacks or cold bottled beverages for your flight.

places.name: Freshen Up! (Nap Rooms & Showers)
places.location: International Terminal, near the entrance to Gates G1 to G14
places.description: Freshen Up! is an essential SFO sanctuary for those enduring long layovers. Whether you need a hot shower to wash away travel fatigue ($30) or a quiet place to recharge, this hidden gem offers private, comfortable nap room suites starting at $150. Beyond the basics, the facility is fully stocked with travel necessities—from toiletries to laundry and pressing services—ensuring you have everything required to reset. Be sure to set multiple alarms so you don't get too comfortable and accidentally sleep past your flight!

places.name: Boudin Bakery
places.location: International Terminal A, Boarding Area A, near Gate A3
places.description: A true San Francisco institution. You cannot leave SFO without grabbing one of their world-famous, freshly baked sourdough bread bowls loaded with hot clam chowder.

places.name: Mama Go’s Filipino Cuisine
places.location: Harvey Milk Terminal 1, near Gate B18
places.description: A massive favorite for authentic Filipino food and regarded as some of the best value for your money at SFO. A casual, comforting staple to grab a warm bite before heading to your gate. Also has vegan and gluten-free options.

photo.credit: Photo courtesy of Mama Go's Filipino Cuisine
